channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Fri Nov 27 — January holds $3.62 after first storage draw
item.description: Deep gas: first draw of −24 Bcf, record LNG feedgas, warm CPC maps; Brent tops $96 before Sunday's OPEC+; Lukoil International sold to US-led group.

item.title: Thu Nov 26 — Dow's 1,100-point reversal; first gas draw
item.description: US Thanksgiving broad brief: hot core PCE locks a Dec Fed hike, Dow erases an 1,100-pt loss, EIA first draw -24 Bcf, Houthis hit Ras Tanura, Calgary budget week.

item.title: Wed Nov 25 — Tech sells off again; Dow tops 50,000; gas braces for early EIA print
item.description: Nasdaq down again as Dow crosses 50,000; December gas expiry and first storage draw of the season expected today; Zelensky pushes four-way talks; Calgary budget fight.

item.title: Tue Nov 24 — Huang back, Nasdaq's best day since April
item.description: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang and the S&P jumps 4.7%; gas tumbles ~7% on vanished heating demand; Brent below $89 on Iran diplomacy; Calgary budget week.

item.title: Mon Nov 23 — Dec gas drops 4% into Wednesday expiry-storage double
item.description: December HH slides ~4% overnight to ~$3.28 after a third straight weekly gain; Wednesday brings Dec expiry plus an early EIA print with the season's first withdrawal in play; FERC clears Sabine Pass expansion; TotalEnergies buys deeper into Anadarko gas.

item.title: Fri Nov 20 — Selloff deepens, loonie at 19-month low
item.description: S&P -2% / TSX six-month low / CAD weakest since Apr 2025 as Fed hike fully priced; EIA +20 Bcf smaller than expected, Dec HH mid-$3.30s; Brent $92 on 3rd weekly decline; Alberta bike-lane bill.

item.title: Thu Nov 19 — Gas rips on cold flip into storage day
item.description: Dec Henry Hub up ~5% to ~.37, highest since late January; EIA +24 Bcf bogey; HDD forecast jumps; Calgary deep freeze; Anthropic trades today.

item.title: Wed Nov 18 — Nvidia beats, Anthropic prices tonight
item.description: Nvidia clears the bar without Huang, futures rebound; Dec HH +2.3% to 3.195; TC Energy's Alberta Growth Connector; Calgary morning snow.

item.title: Tue Nov 17 — Nvidia tonight as tech slide deepens
item.description: Tech selloff round three ahead of Nvidia's post-Huang print; Dec Henry Hub settles 3.12; CNQ buys Advantage for C$2.53B; Crimea Bridge span down; Calgary snowfall warning.

item.title: Mon Nov 16 — Gas fades into the cold week, record LNG
item.description: Dec Henry Hub slips ~3% to the low $3.20s into the season's first cold snap; record 21.2 Bcf/d LNG feedgas; +61 Bcf build widens surplus to +2%; LNG Canada maintenance keeps AECO heavy.

item.title: Fri Nov 13 — Huang out at Nvidia, hike priced, oil jumps
item.description: Broad: Nvidia CEO resigns, 10-yr above 5% with Dec hike priced, Brent +3.3% on Houthi attacks; HH +4% to $3.34, storage report delayed to today.

item.title: Thu Nov 12 — Henry Hub highest close since February
item.description: Dec HH settles $3.353 (+2%, ~12% on the week) on short covering and cold; EIA storage Friday; LNG Canada two-train maintenance; CPC warm flip is the risk.

item.title: Wed Nov 11 — Hot CPI locks December hike; tens kiss five percent
item.description: CPI +0.4% locks a December Fed hike (11% odds of 50bp), 10-yr above 5% intraday; futures rebound on CoreWeave; HH settles $3.296, a seven-week high; Brent briefly under $90; Calgary budget charts a $10B debt arc.

item.title: Tue Nov 10 — Best S&P day since April; gas up seven percent
item.description: Stocks soar as oil crashes on Iran de-escalation hopes; Dec Henry Hub +7% near $3.21; CPI today with a December hike priced; Abu Dhabi Russia-Ukraine talks open.
